attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as the DNS resolver for the shared private network 10.100.50.0/24: it authoritatively answers inventory.internal with node2's address (10.100.50.11) via a VyOS authoritative-domain zone, and forwards all other queries upstream to 10.100.50.1. Configured node2 and node3 (RHEL10) via NetworkManager to use node1 (10.100.50.10) as their sole DNS resolver. Verified resolution end-to-end from both client nodes, then restarted all three nodes one at a time, confirming changed boot identity and full recovery of DNS service/config after each restart.
